notes.title: Demo version finished
notes.content:
I finished work on the demo version, I will always be glad to receive your comments.
The demo version has two levels with several types of opponents, two weapons and one boss.
Have a nice day.

notes.title: Retro style first person shooter
notes.content:
Hi. I am working on a new project. This is a retro style first person shooter with a lot of enemies.
the page is already available. Go on, take a look and if you like it, add it to your wishlist.
Thank you for attention.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1573110/Azy__Old_School_FPS/

P. s.
I have not abandoned the project and updates will come out.
